author: TeIq
content: Design doc drafted: .design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md. 10 requirements, 11 acceptance criteria, 3 open questions (wasm-readiness gating, labeler signing-key custody, frontend lexicon validation). Decisions resolved in interview: Polaris hosts the labeler XRPC endpoint via proto-blue-xrpc server; pluggable ModeratorAuth (OIDC + ATProto OAuth); hybrid frontend (public-direct via wasm proto-blue, private-proxied via Axum); internal types stay plain Rust.
